assertions.assertion: The patient presents with a history of recurrent palpitations and intermittent episodes of syncope, raising concern for paroxysmal supraventricular tachycardia
The ordered CPT 93247 long-term continuous electrocardiogram monitoring study is medically necessary to correlate these symptomatic events with underlying cardiac rhythm disturbances
A 30-day continuous ambulatory ECG monitoring study is required for comprehensive evaluation of these symptomatic cardiac events
